targets.quality_label: Noether Paper 04 RA64 targeted German source-critical candidate, printed p.152 heading footnote
targets.coverage: Paper 04, `Zur Invariantentheorie der Formen von n Variabeln`, printed pp.148-152 checked in this pass, with patched page p.152. The package includes a compiled 430-page cumulative German RA64 candidate TeX/PDF/log, RA63-to-RA64 diff, Paper 04 tail source cutout, full-page and targeted 1000dpi inspection crops for the repaired heading footnote, confirmed-fix CSV, no-new-patch traps, source witness manifest, summary JSON, extracted text, and checksums. The package summary reports 1 confirmed repair, 3 no-new-patch traps, and two pdflatex passes.
targets.findings: The confirmed repair restores the missing source-visible footnote attached to the Section 9 heading `§ 9. Formenreihen. Reduktionssätze`. The no-new-patch traps confirm that Formula (65) RHS product notation, the `n=2\lambda` special case order, and the `q_{n-\sigma-\lambda},p_{\tau-\lambda}` variable pair were already correct in RA63.
targets.limitations: This is a narrow targeted German source-critical candidate only. The 1000dpi images are inspection renders from the staged Paper 04 tail source cutout, not an independent high-resolution source. It is not full Paper 04 certification, not whole-corpus source closure, not a critical edition, and not propagated to EN/ES/JA/FR/ZH/UK/RU/ISV or the newer Slavic branches. RA64 builds from the RA63 candidate, and branch reconciliation with other Noether candidates remains required before any reader promotion.
